title: The free energy of the spherical random perceptron
summary: We prove an exact variational formula for the limiting pressure of the spherical random perceptron with an arbitrary bounded continuous single-pattern potential. The formula holds at every fixed positive density and inverse temperature, with convergence in expectation and in probability.
family_title: Perceptron free energies and microscopic jamming exponents

review.reason: Proves a variational formula for the free energy of the spherical random perceptron.
